build.description: Rebuild everything this stack runs, even what hasn't changed.

no-build.description: Start without building, even when a build output is missing.

web.description: Use your local SDK and toolkit builds: start the local registry, build and publish them, point the extensions at them, and rebuild on every save.

no-logs.description: Don't forward logs to Grafana. Terminal and files only.

full.description: Full-stack work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts, all Scala services, the portal and its extensions, all on this machine.

backend.description: Backend work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts and all Scala services. No portal.

csharp-portal.description: C# and portal work: Docker dependencies, C# hosts, the Scala services they call and the ones needed to log in, the portal and its extensions.

portal-extensions.description: Portal and extension work: the portal and its extensions against the dev backend. Nothing else runs on this machine.

web-dev.description: Web SDK and toolkit work: the local package registry, your SDK and toolkit builds, the portal and its extensions, against the dev backend.

non-publish.description: Type-check loop: build the packages, never publish them or point the extensions at them.

remote.description: Microservice and extension work on a remote realm: this workspace's microservices and portal extensions, registered against dev and used from the hosted portal.
